        Profile: High Brightness Updates
        	State: Variable Value  [ %AAB_AdaptiveHandoff ~ 1 & %AAB_Service ~ On & %AAB_Manual_Override !~ true ]

        Enter Task: _ReadBrightness
        
        A1: Variable Set [
             Name: %current_sys_bright
             To: %AAB_CurrentBright
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A2: Java Code [
             Code: 
             import android.os.Build;
             import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
             import java.util.regex.*;
             import com.joaomgcd.taskerm.shell.CommandResult;
             
             /* --- Validate Calibration --- */
             
             cal = tasker.getVariable("AAB_BrightCal");
             
             if (cal == null || cal.length() == 0 ||
                 cal.equals("error")) {
                 return;
             }
             
             if (!Build.FINGERPRINT.equals(
                     tasker.getVariable("AAB_BrightCalFP"))) {
             
                 tasker.setVariable("AAB_NeedsCal", "true");
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Select Execution Backend --- */
             
             privilege = tasker.getVariable("AAB_SecondaryPrivilege");
             
             if (privilege == null) {
                 privilege = "None";
             }
             
             privilege = privilege.trim();
             
             command = "dumpsys display";
             timeout = 5;
             output = null;
             
             try {
             
                 if (privilege.equals("Root")) {
             
                     result = tasker.runShellRoot(command, timeout);
             
                 } else if (privilege.equals("ADB WiFi")) {
             
                     result = tasker.runShellAdbWifi(command, timeout);
             
                 } else if (privilege.equals("Shizuku")) {
             
                     result = tasker.runShellShizuku(command, timeout);
             
                 } else {
             
                     /* Fallback: Tasker with DUMP permission */
             
                     if (context.checkSelfPermission(
                             "android.permission.DUMP")
                             != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
             
                         tasker.log(
                             "AAB: DUMP permission unavailable."
                         );
                         return;
                     }
             
                     result = tasker.runShellTasker(command, timeout);
                 }
             
                 if (result == null || !result.getSuccess()) {
             
                     tasker.log(
                         "AAB: Display read failed via " + privilege
                     );
                     return;
                 }
             
                 output = result.getOutputString();
             
             } catch (Throwable e) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Display shell error (" +
                     privilege + "): " + e
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             if (output == null || output.length() == 0) {
                 tasker.log("AAB: Empty display output.");
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Extract Raw Display Brightness --- */
             
             raw = -1.0;
             
             try {
             
                 pat = Pattern.compile(
                     "(?:mScreenBrightness|" +
                     "mDisplayBrightness|" +
                     "mCurrentScreenBrightness)=" +
                     "([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)"
                 );
             
                 matcher = pat.matcher(output);
             
                 if (matcher.find()) {
                     raw = Double.parseDouble(matcher.group(1));
                 }
             
             } catch (Exception e) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Brightness parsing failed: " + e
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             if (raw < 0 ||
                 Double.isNaN(raw) ||
                 Double.isInfinite(raw)) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: No valid brightness in display output."
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Parse Calibration Points --- */
             
             try {
             
                 parts = cal.split(",");
                 n = parts.length;
             
                 if (n < 2) {
                     tasker.log(
                         "AAB: Insufficient calibration points."
                     );
                     return;
                 }
             
                 vs = new double[n];
                 rs = new double[n];
             
                 for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
             
                     kv = parts[i].trim().split(":");
             
                     if (kv.length != 2) {
                         throw new Exception(
                             "Invalid calibration point " + i
                         );
                     }
             
                     vs[i] = Double.parseDouble(kv[0].trim());
                     rs[i] = Double.parseDouble(kv[1].trim());
             
                     if (Double.isNaN(vs[i]) ||
                         Double.isInfinite(vs[i]) ||
                         Double.isNaN(rs[i]) ||
                         Double.isInfinite(rs[i])) {
             
                         throw new Exception(
                             "Non-finite calibration point " + i
                         );
                     }
             
                     /* Raw values must be strictly increasing */
             
                     if (i > 0 && rs[i] <= rs[i - 1]) {
                         throw new Exception(
                             "Calibration raw values not increasing"
                         );
                     }
                 }
             
             } catch (Exception e) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Invalid brightness calibration: " + e
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Convert Raw to Calibrated Brightness --- */
             
             if (raw <= rs[0]) {
             
                 /* Below calibration range: clamp to minimum */
             
                 v = vs[0];
             
             } else if (raw > rs[n - 1]) {
             
                 /* Above calibration range: extrapolate */
             
                 span = rs[n - 1] - rs[n - 2];
             
                 slope = (vs[n - 1] - vs[n - 2]) / span;
             
                 v = vs[n - 1] +
                     (raw - rs[n - 1]) * slope;
             
             } else {
             
                 /* Within calibration range: interpolate */
             
                 v = vs[n - 1];
             
                 for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
             
                     if (raw <= rs[i]) {
             
                         fraction = (raw - rs[i - 1]) /
                                    (rs[i] - rs[i - 1]);
             
                         v = vs[i - 1] +
                             fraction * (vs[i] - vs[i - 1]);
             
                         break;
                     }
                 }
             }
             
             /* --- Validate and Store Results --- */
             
             if (Double.isNaN(v) || Double.isInfinite(v)) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Invalid calibrated brightness result."
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             tasker.setVariable(
                 "AAB_DisplayRaw",
                 String.valueOf(raw)
             );
             
             tasker.setVariable(
                 "AAB_CurrentBright",
                 String.valueOf(Math.round(v))
             );
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]

            A15: Java Code [
                  Code: /* --- Java Code for Dynamic Threshold Calculation --- */
                 
                 /* Read all necessary Tasker variables */
                 double par1 = %par1;
                 double SmoothedLux = %SmoothedLux;
                 double AAB_ThreshDim = %AAB_ThreshDim;
                 double AAB_ThreshBright = %AAB_ThreshBright;
                 double AAB_ThreshSteepness = %AAB_ThreshSteepness;
                 double AAB_ThreshMidpoint = %AAB_ThreshMidpoint;
                 double AAB_ThreshDark = %AAB_ThreshDark;
                 double AAB_Zone1End = %AAB_Zone1End;
                 
                 /* A15 & A16: Calculate relative_change */
                 double lux_difference = Math.abs(par1 - SmoothedLux);
                 double relative_change = Math.round((lux_difference / (SmoothedLux + 1.0)) * 1000.0) / 1000.0;
                 
                 /* A17: Calculate the sigmoid threshold for brighter light */
                 double log_lux = Math.log10(SmoothedLux + 1.0);
                 double exponent = -AAB_ThreshSteepness * (log_lux - AAB_ThreshMidpoint);
                 double thresh_sig = AAB_ThreshDim + (AAB_ThreshBright - AAB_ThreshDim) / (1.0 + Math.exp(exponent));
                 thresh_sig = Math.round(thresh_sig * 1000.0) / 1000.0;
                 
                 /* A18: Calculate the linear threshold for dim light */
                 double thresh_low = AAB_ThreshDark - ((AAB_ThreshDark - AAB_ThreshDim) / AAB_Zone1End) * SmoothedLux;
                 thresh_low = Math.round(thresh_low * 1000.0) / 1000.0;
                 
                 /* A19-A23: Choose the correct threshold based on the current lux */
                 double dynamic_threshold;
                 if (SmoothedLux < AAB_Zone1End) {
                     dynamic_threshold = thresh_low;
                 } else {
                     dynamic_threshold = thresh_sig;
                 }
                 
                 /* --- MODIFIED SECTION --- */
                 /* Set the Tasker variables directly */
                 tasker.setVariable("relative_change", String.valueOf(relative_change));
                 tasker.setVariable("dynamic_threshold", String.valueOf(dynamic_threshold)); ]

              Code: /* --- Java Code for Dynamic Threshold Calculation --- */
             
             /* Read all necessary Tasker variables */
             double par1 = %par1;
             double SmoothedLux = %SmoothedLux;
             double AAB_ThreshDim = %AAB_ThreshDim;
             double AAB_ThreshBright = %AAB_ThreshBright;
             double AAB_ThreshSteepness = %AAB_ThreshSteepness;
             double AAB_ThreshMidpoint = %AAB_ThreshMidpoint;
             double AAB_ThreshDark = %AAB_ThreshDark;
             double AAB_Zone1End = %AAB_Zone1End;
             
             /* A15 & A16: Calculate relative_change */
             double lux_difference = Math.abs(par1 - SmoothedLux);
             double relative_change = Math.round((lux_difference / (SmoothedLux + 1.0)) * 1000.0) / 1000.0;
             
             /* A17: Calculate the sigmoid threshold for brighter light */
             double log_lux = Math.log10(SmoothedLux + 1.0);
             double exponent = -AAB_ThreshSteepness * (log_lux - AAB_ThreshMidpoint);
             double thresh_sig = AAB_ThreshDim + (AAB_ThreshBright - AAB_ThreshDim) / (1.0 + Math.exp(exponent));
             thresh_sig = Math.round(thresh_sig * 1000.0) / 1000.0;
             
             /* A18: Calculate the linear threshold for dim light */
             double thresh_low = AAB_ThreshDark - ((AAB_ThreshDark - AAB_ThreshDim) / AAB_Zone1End) * SmoothedLux;
             thresh_low = Math.round(thresh_low * 1000.0) / 1000.0;
             
             /* A19-A23: Choose the correct threshold based on the current lux */

                 dynamic_threshold = thresh_sig;

        Task: _DetermineMinHand-offThresh
        
        A1: Java Code [
             Code: import com.joaomgcd.taskerm.action.java.JavaCodeException;
             
             /* Define helper function to calculate base brightness */
             calcBrightness(lux, params) {
                 if (lux < params[0]) {
                     return params[2] * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.0, lux));
                 } else if (lux < params[1]) {
                     t1 = Math.pow(Math.max(0.0, lux - params[5]), 0.33);
                     t2 = Math.pow(Math.max(0.0, params[0] - params[5]), 0.33);
                     return params[3] + params[4] * (t1 - t2);
                 } else {
                     if (lux <= 0.0) {
                         return 0.0;
                     }
                     return params[7] - (params[6] / lux) * params[7];
                 }
             }
             
             /* Gather all required Tasker parameters */
             varNames = new String[]{
                 "AAB_Zone1End", 
                 "AAB_Zone2End", 
                 "AAB_Form1A", 
                 "AAB_Form2A", 
                 "AAB_Form2B", 
                 "AAB_Form2C", 
                 "AAB_Form3A", 
                 "AAB_MaxBright"
             };
             
             p = new double[8];
             
             for (int i = 0; i < varNames.length; i++) {
                 val = tasker.getVariable(varNames[i]);
                 if (val == null || val == void || val.trim().length() == 0) {
                     throw new JavaCodeException("Missing required Tasker variable: " + varNames[i]);
                 }
                 try {
                     p[i] = Double.parseDouble(val.trim());
                 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                     throw new JavaCodeException("Invalid numeric value for variable: " + varNames[i]);
                 }
             }
             
             targetBright = 0.9 * p[7];
             analyticalZone3Lux = 10.0 * p[6];
             
             minimumAllowedLux = 0.0;
             
             /* Check if target is in Zone 3 analytically */
             if (analyticalZone3Lux >= p[1]) {
                 minimumAllowedLux = analyticalZone3Lux;
             } else {
                 /* Binary search the monotonic curve if target falls below Zone 3 */
                 low = 0.0;
                 high = Math.max(p[1], 10000.0);
                 for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                     mid = (low + high) / 2.0;
                     if (calcBrightness(mid, p) >= targetBright) {
                         high = mid;
                     } else {
                         low = mid;
                     }
                 }
                 minimumAllowedLux = high;
             }
             
             /* Format display matching the JS implementation */
             intVal = Math.round(minimumAllowedLux);
             intValDouble = intVal * 1.0;
             
             /* Check if the rounded integer value fulfills the target mathematically */
             if (Math.abs(minimumAllowedLux - intValDouble) < 0.005 && calcBrightness(intValDouble, p) >= targetBright - 1e-5) {
                 return String.valueOf(intVal);
             }
             
             /* Fallback to checking two decimal precision */
             decValRound = Math.round(minimumAllowedLux * 100.0);
             decVal = decValRound / 100.0;
             
             if (calcBrightness(decVal, p) < targetBright - 1e-5) {
                 decValCeil = Math.ceil(minimumAllowedLux * 100.0);
                 decVal = decValCeil / 100.0;
             }
             
             return String.valueOf(decVal);
             Return: %min
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]

        Task: _CalibrateDisplayRange
        
        A1: Variable Set [
             Name: %temp_service
             To: %AAB_Service
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A2: Perform Task [
             Name: _QSToggleAABService V2
             Priority: %priority
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
            If  [ %temp_service ~ On ]
        
        A3: Java Code [
             Code: import android.provider.Settings;
             import android.os.Build;
             import java.io.BufferedReader;
             import java.io.InputStreamReader;
             import java.util.regex.Pattern;
             import java.util.regex.Matcher;
             
             /* Invalidate calibration state while keeping the active running status for the UI. */
             tasker.setVariable("AAB_NeedsCal", "true");
             tasker.setVariable("AAB_BrightCal", "running");
             
             cr = context.getContentResolver();
             pat = Pattern.compile("(mScreenBrightness|mDisplayBrightness|mCurrentScreenBrightness)=([0-9.]+)");
             lockedField = null;
             
             readRaw() {
                 p = null;
                 r = null;
                 try {
                     p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(new String[]{"dumpsys", "display"});
                     r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream()));
                     while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) {
                         m = pat.matcher(line);
                         if (m.find()) {
                             field = m.group(1);
                             /* Ensure all measurements lock to the identical OEM display field. */
                             if (lockedField != null && !field.equals(lockedField)) {
                                 continue;
                             }
                             v = Double.parseDouble(m.group(2));
                             if (!Double.isNaN(v) && !Double.isInfinite(v)) {
                                 if (lockedField == null) {
                                     lockedField = field;
                                 }
                                 return v;
                             }
                         }
                     }
                 } catch (Exception e) {
                     tasker.log("AAB: dumpsys read failed: " + e);
                 } finally {
                     try {
                         if (r != null) {
                             r.close();
                         }
                     } catch (Exception e) {}
                     if (p != null) {
                         p.destroy();
                     }
                 }
                 return -1.0;
             }
             
             /* Wait until the reading stops ramping, moves off previous point, and stabilizes. */
             readStable(prev) {
                 last = -2.0;
                 start = System.currentTimeMillis();
                 while (System.currentTimeMillis() - start < 3000) {
                     Thread.sleep(150);
                     v = readRaw();
                     if (v >= 0 && v == last && v != prev) {
                         return v;
                     }
                     last = v;
                 }
                 return -1.0;
             }
             
             origMode = Settings.System.getInt(cr, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_MODE, 0);
             origBright = Settings.System.getInt(cr, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS, 128);
             pts = new int[]{1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100, 128, 150, 175, 200, 225, 255};
             raws = new double[pts.length];
             ok = true;
             restoreOk = true;
             
             try {
                 if (!Settings.System.putInt(cr, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_MODE, 0)) {
                     ok = false;
                 }
                 prev = -1.0;
                 for (i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
                     if (!ok) {
                         break;
                     }
                     if (!Settings.System.putInt(cr, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS, pts[i])) {
                         ok = false;
                         break;
                     }
                     if (i == 0) {
                         Thread.sleep(800);
                     }
                     raws[i] = readStable(prev);
                     if (raws[i] < 0 || (i > 0 && raws[i] < raws[i - 1])) {
                         ok = false;
                         break;
                     }
                     prev = raws[i];
                 }
                 if (ok && (raws.length != 13 || raws[pts.length - 1] <= raws[0])) {
                     ok = false;
                 }
             } catch (Exception e) {
                 tasker.log("AAB: Calibration error: " + e);
                 ok = false;
             } finally {
                 try {
                     if (!Settings.System.putInt(cr, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS, origBright)) {
                         tasker.log("AAB: Failed to restore original brightness.");
                         restoreOk = false;
                     }
                 } catch (Exception e) {
                     tasker.log("AAB: Brightness restoration exception: " + e);
                     restoreOk = false;
                 }
                 try {
                     if (!Settings.System.putInt(cr, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_MODE, origMode)) {
                         tasker.log("AAB: Failed to restore brightness mode.");
                         restoreOk = false;
                     }
                 } catch (Exception e) {
                     tasker.log("AAB: Brightness mode restoration exception: " + e);
                     restoreOk = false;
                 }
             }
             
             if (!ok || !restoreOk) {
                 tasker.setVariable("AAB_BrightCal", "error");
                 return "error";
             }
             
             sb = new StringBuilder();
             for (i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
                 if (i > 0) {
                     sb.append(",");
                 }
                 sb.append(pts[i]).append(":").append(raws[i]);
             }
             cal = sb.toString();
             
             tasker.setVariable("AAB_BrightCal", cal);
             tasker.setVariable("AAB_BrightCalFP", Build.FINGERPRINT);
             tasker.setVariable("AAB_NeedsCal", "false");
             return "ok";
             Return: %cal_result
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On
             Continue Task After Error:On ]
        
        A4: If [ %cal_result !~ ok ]

                 Long: On

        Task: _ReadBrightness
        
        A1: Variable Set [
             Name: %current_sys_bright
             To: %AAB_CurrentBright
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A2: Java Code [
             Code: 
             import android.os.Build;
             import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
             import java.util.regex.*;
             import com.joaomgcd.taskerm.shell.CommandResult;
             
             /* --- Validate Calibration --- */
             
             cal = tasker.getVariable("AAB_BrightCal");
             
             if (cal == null || cal.length() == 0 ||
                 cal.equals("error")) {
                 return;
             }
             
             if (!Build.FINGERPRINT.equals(
                     tasker.getVariable("AAB_BrightCalFP"))) {
             
                 tasker.setVariable("AAB_NeedsCal", "true");
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Select Execution Backend --- */
             
             privilege = tasker.getVariable("AAB_SecondaryPrivilege");
             
             if (privilege == null) {
                 privilege = "None";
             }
             
             privilege = privilege.trim();
             
             command = "dumpsys display";
             timeout = 5;
             output = null;
             
             try {
             
                 if (privilege.equals("Root")) {
             
                     result = tasker.runShellRoot(command, timeout);
             
                 } else if (privilege.equals("ADB WiFi")) {
             
                     result = tasker.runShellAdbWifi(command, timeout);
             
                 } else if (privilege.equals("Shizuku")) {
             
                     result = tasker.runShellShizuku(command, timeout);
             
                 } else {
             
                     /* Fallback: Tasker with DUMP permission */
             
                     if (context.checkSelfPermission(
                             "android.permission.DUMP")
                             != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
             
                         tasker.log(
                             "AAB: DUMP permission unavailable."
                         );
                         return;
                     }
             
                     result = tasker.runShellTasker(command, timeout);
                 }
             
                 if (result == null || !result.getSuccess()) {
             
                     tasker.log(
                         "AAB: Display read failed via " + privilege
                     );
                     return;
                 }
             
                 output = result.getOutputString();
             
             } catch (Throwable e) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Display shell error (" +
                     privilege + "): " + e
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             if (output == null || output.length() == 0) {
                 tasker.log("AAB: Empty display output.");
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Extract Raw Display Brightness --- */
             
             raw = -1.0;
             
             try {
             
                 pat = Pattern.compile(
                     "(?:mScreenBrightness|" +
                     "mDisplayBrightness|" +
                     "mCurrentScreenBrightness)=" +
                     "([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)"
                 );
             
                 matcher = pat.matcher(output);
             
                 if (matcher.find()) {
                     raw = Double.parseDouble(matcher.group(1));
                 }
             
             } catch (Exception e) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Brightness parsing failed: " + e
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             if (raw < 0 ||
                 Double.isNaN(raw) ||
                 Double.isInfinite(raw)) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: No valid brightness in display output."
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Parse Calibration Points --- */
             
             try {
             
                 parts = cal.split(",");
                 n = parts.length;
             
                 if (n < 2) {
                     tasker.log(
                         "AAB: Insufficient calibration points."
                     );
                     return;
                 }
             
                 vs = new double[n];
                 rs = new double[n];
             
                 for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
             
                     kv = parts[i].trim().split(":");
             
                     if (kv.length != 2) {
                         throw new Exception(
                             "Invalid calibration point " + i
                         );
                     }
             
                     vs[i] = Double.parseDouble(kv[0].trim());
                     rs[i] = Double.parseDouble(kv[1].trim());
             
                     if (Double.isNaN(vs[i]) ||
                         Double.isInfinite(vs[i]) ||
                         Double.isNaN(rs[i]) ||
                         Double.isInfinite(rs[i])) {
             
                         throw new Exception(
                             "Non-finite calibration point " + i
                         );
                     }
             
                     /* Raw values must be strictly increasing */
             
                     if (i > 0 && rs[i] <= rs[i - 1]) {
                         throw new Exception(
                             "Calibration raw values not increasing"
                         );
                     }
                 }
             
             } catch (Exception e) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Invalid brightness calibration: " + e
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             /* --- Convert Raw to Calibrated Brightness --- */
             
             if (raw <= rs[0]) {
             
                 /* Below calibration range: clamp to minimum */
             
                 v = vs[0];
             
             } else if (raw > rs[n - 1]) {
             
                 /* Above calibration range: extrapolate */
             
                 span = rs[n - 1] - rs[n - 2];
             
                 slope = (vs[n - 1] - vs[n - 2]) / span;
             
                 v = vs[n - 1] +
                     (raw - rs[n - 1]) * slope;
             
             } else {
             
                 /* Within calibration range: interpolate */
             
                 v = vs[n - 1];
             
                 for (i = 1; i < n; i++) {
             
                     if (raw <= rs[i]) {
             
                         fraction = (raw - rs[i - 1]) /
                                    (rs[i] - rs[i - 1]);
             
                         v = vs[i - 1] +
                             fraction * (vs[i] - vs[i - 1]);
             
                         break;
                     }
                 }
             }
             
             /* --- Validate and Store Results --- */
             
             if (Double.isNaN(v) || Double.isInfinite(v)) {
             
                 tasker.log(
                     "AAB: Invalid calibrated brightness result."
                 );
                 return;
             }
             
             tasker.setVariable(
                 "AAB_DisplayRaw",
                 String.valueOf(raw)
             );
             
             tasker.setVariable(
                 "AAB_CurrentBright",
                 String.valueOf(Math.round(v))
             );
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A3: Stop [ ]
            If  [ %current_sys_bright ~ %AAB_CurrentBright ]
        
        A4: If [ %AAB_CurrentBright > 255 ]
        
            A5: Flash [
                 Text: High Brightness Mode activated. 
                 Long: On
                 Tasker Layout: On
                 Background Colour: #FF007C63
                 Continue Task Immediately: On
                 Dismiss On Click: On
                 ID: aab_toast ]
                If  [ %AAB_HBMFlag !~ 1 ]
        
            A6: Variable Set [
                 Name: %AAB_HBMFlag
                 To: 1
                 Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]

        A7: Else
        
            A8: Flash [
                 Text: High Brightness Mode disabled
                 Long: On
                 Tasker Layout: On
                 Background Colour: #FF007C63

                 Dismiss On Click: On

        Task: Set Initial Brightness (Java) V3

        A1: Variable Set [
             Name: %AAB_Initializing

             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]

             Name: Initialize AAB Defaults
             Priority: %priority
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
            If  [ %AAB_SetupComplete neq 1 ]
        
        A4: Variable Set [
             Name: %counter

        Task: Smooth Brightness Transition V5 (Java)
        
        A1: Multiple Variables Set [
             Names: %AAB_LastAnimation=%TIMEMS
             %AAB_CycleTime=%TIMEMS - %AAB_CycleStart
             Values Splitter: =
             Do Maths: On
             Max Rounding Digits: 3
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A2: Variable Set [
             Name: %AutoBrightRunning
             To: 1
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A3: Profile Status [
             Name: Allow Override
             Set: Off ]
        
        A4: If [ %AAB_AdaptiveHandoff ~ 1 & %AAB_BrightCal !~ error & %AAB_BrightCal Set ]
        
            A5: Perform Task [
                 Name: _ReadBrightness
                 Priority: %priority
                 Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A6: End If
        
        A7: Java Code [
             Code: import android.provider.Settings;
             import android.content.ContentResolver;
             
             /* --- Safe Initialization Phase --- */
             
             /* 1. Get Content Resolver */
             cResolver = context.getContentResolver();
             
             try {
             
                 /* 2. Get Current Brightness (Safely) */
                 try {
                     startBrightness = Settings.System.getInt(cResolver, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS);
                 } catch (Exception e) {
                     tasker.log("AAB: Could not read system brightness. Aborting.");
                     return;
                 }
             
                 /* 3. Check Adaptive Handoff State Before Starting */
                 adaptiveHandoffStr = tasker.getVariable("AAB_AdaptiveHandoff");
                 adaptiveHandoff = (adaptiveHandoffStr != null && adaptiveHandoffStr.equals("1"));
             
                 if (adaptiveHandoff) {
                     tasker.log("AAB: Adaptive handoff active. Android owns brightness. Aborting.");
                     return;
                 }
             
                 /* 4. Get Target Brightness (%par1) */
                 targetStr = tasker.getVariable("par1");
                 if (targetStr == null) {
                     tasker.log("AAB: No target brightness (%par1) set. Aborting.");
                     return;
                 }
                 targetBrightness = Double.parseDouble(targetStr);
             
                 /* 5. Get Configuration (%par2 -> loops,wait) */
                 par2 = tasker.getVariable("par2");
                 if (par2 == null) par2 = "20,30"; /* Default safety fallback */
                 parts = par2.split(",");
                 loops = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                 wait = Long.parseLong(parts[1]);
             
                 /* 6. Get Global Settings */
                 dimmingThresholdStr = tasker.getVariable("AAB_DimmingThreshold");
                 dimmingThreshold = (dimmingThresholdStr != null) ? Double.parseDouble(dimmingThresholdStr) : 5.0;
             
                 dimmingEnabledStr = tasker.getVariable("AAB_DimmingEnabled");
                 dimmingEnabled = (dimmingEnabledStr != null && dimmingEnabledStr.equals("true"));
             
                 detectOverridesStr = tasker.getVariable("AAB_DetectOverrides");
                 detectOverrides = (detectOverridesStr != null && detectOverridesStr.equals("On"));
             
                 /* 7. Calculate Min/Max Targets */
                 if (startBrightness < targetBrightness) {
                     minTarget = startBrightness;
                     maxTarget = targetBrightness + 1;
                 } else {
                     minTarget = targetBrightness - 1;
                     maxTarget = startBrightness;
                 }
             
                 /* Export these for the Debug Flash (A13) */
                 tasker.setVariable("max_target", String.valueOf(maxTarget));
                 tasker.setVariable("min_target", String.valueOf(minTarget));
                 tasker.setVariable("loops", String.valueOf(loops));
                 tasker.setVariable("wait", String.valueOf(wait));
             
                 /* --- Execution Phase --- */
             
                 engineStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                 consecutiveOutOfBounds = 0;
                 overrideTriggerThreshold = 2;
                 previousBrightnessInt = -1;
             
                 tasker.log("--- Starting AAB Animation: " + startBrightness + " -> " + targetBrightness + " ---");
             
                 for (int counter = 0; counter < loops; counter++) {
             
                     /* Synchronize Hand-off: Yield immediately if Android took ownership */  
                     if ("1".equals(tasker.getVariable("AAB_AdaptiveHandoff"))) {  
                         tasker.log("AAB: Adaptive handoff engaged mid-animation. Relinquishing control.");  
                         break;  
                     }  
             
                     /* Check for manual stop flag */  
                     override = tasker.getVariable("AAB_Manual_Override");  
                     if ("true".equals(override)) {  
                         tasker.log("Manual override detected via variable. Stopping.");  
                         break;  
                     }  
             
                     /* Calculate interpolation reaching 100% on the final step */  
                     progress = (loops <= 1) ? 1.0 : (double) counter / (loops - 1);  
                     calculated_brightness_smooth = startBrightness + progress * (targetBrightness - startBrightness);  
                     
                     /* Apply Brightness to System */  
                     brightnessInt = (int) Math.round(calculated_brightness_smooth);  
                     if (brightnessInt < 0) brightnessInt = 0;  
                     if (brightnessInt > 255) brightnessInt = 255;  
                     
                     /* Write to hardware only if value changed; verify write success before updating cache */  
                     if (brightnessInt != previousBrightnessInt) {  
             
                         /* Recheck ownership immediately before writing */  
                         if ("1".equals(tasker.getVariable("AAB_AdaptiveHandoff"))) {  
                             tasker.log("AAB: Handoff engaged before hardware write.");  
                             break;  
                         }  
             
                         try {  
                             if (Settings.System.putInt(  
                                     cResolver,  
                                     Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS,  
                                     brightnessInt)) {  
                                 previousBrightnessInt = brightnessInt;  
                             } else {  
                                 tasker.log("AAB: Brightness write failed.");  
                                 break;  
                             }  
                         } catch (Exception e) {  
                             tasker.log("AAB: Brightness write exception: " + e);  
                             break;  
                         }  
                     }  
                     
                     /* OPTIMIZATION: Update Tasker variables and check overrides every 5th frame */  
                     if (counter % 5 == 0 || counter == loops - 1) {  
                         
                         /* 1. Format Display Variable */  
                         AAB_CurrentBright_str = "";  
                         if (calculated_brightness_smooth < dimmingThreshold) {  
                             roundedVal = Math.round(calculated_brightness_smooth * 10.0) / 10.0;  
                             AAB_CurrentBright_str = String.valueOf(roundedVal);  
                         } else {  
                             AAB_CurrentBright_str = String.valueOf(Math.round(calculated_brightness_smooth));  
                         }  
                         
                         /* 2. Update Global Variable (Displayed brightness) */  
                         tasker.setVariable("AAB_CurrentBright", AAB_CurrentBright_str);  
             
                         /* 3. Dimming Decider Hook */  
                         if (dimmingEnabled) {  
                             tasker.callTask("Dimming Decider", null);  
                         }  
                         
                         /* 4. Override Detection */  
                         if (detectOverrides) {  
                             try {  
                                 actualSystemBrightness = Settings.System.getInt(cResolver, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS);  
                                 
                                 if (actualSystemBrightness > maxTarget + 2 || actualSystemBrightness < minTarget - 2) {  
                                     consecutiveOutOfBounds++;  
                                     
                                     if (consecutiveOutOfBounds >= overrideTriggerThreshold) {  
                                         tasker.log("Hardware override detected (System: " + actualSystemBrightness + " vs Calc: " + brightnessInt + "). Stopping.");  
                                         tasker.setVariable("AAB_Manual_Override", "true");  
                                         tasker.callTask("Manual Override", null);  
                                         break;  
                                     }  
                                 } else {  
                                     consecutiveOutOfBounds = 0;  
                                 }  
                             } catch (Exception e) {  
                                 /* Ignore read errors during loop */  
                             }  
                         }  
                     }  
             
                     /* Self-Adjusting Wait */  
                     timeSpentSoFar = System.currentTimeMillis() - engineStartTime;  
                     targetTimeForStep = (long)((counter + 1) * wait);  
                     adjustedWait = targetTimeForStep - timeSpentSoFar;  
                     
                     try {  
                         if (adjustedWait > 0 && counter < loops - 1) {  
                             Thread.sleep(adjustedWait);  
                         }  
                     } catch (InterruptedException e) {  
                         break;  
                     }  
                 }
             
                 engineEndTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                 tasker.setVariable("java_loop_duration", String.valueOf(engineEndTime - engineStartTime));
             
             } catch (Exception e) {
                 tasker.log("AAB: Animation error: " + e);
             } finally {
                 tasker.setVariable("AutoBrightRunning", "0");
             }
             Structure Output (JSON, etc): On ]
        
        A8: Profile Status [
             Name: Allow Override
             Set: On ]
        
        A9: Flash [
             Text: Hardware mode
             Loops: %loops, wait step: %wait ms
             Java loop duration: %java_loop_duration ms
             Target brightness: %AAB_CurrentBright
             Maximum target: %max_target
             Minimum target: %min_target
             Long: On
             Tasker Layout: On
             Background Colour: #FF007C63
             Continue Task Immediately: On
             Dismiss On Click: On ]
            If  [ %AAB_Debug ~ 2 ]
        
        A10: Java Code [
              Code: import java.util.HashMap;
             import android.provider.Settings;
             import android.content.ContentResolver;
             
             /* --- Start Timer --- */
             engineStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
             
             /* --- Read Parameters --- */
             targetBrightness = Double.parseDouble(tasker.getVariable("calculated_brightness"));
             finalDim = Double.parseDouble(tasker.getVariable("final_dim"));
             loops = Integer.parseInt(tasker.getVariable("loops"));
             wait = Integer.parseInt(tasker.getVariable("wait"));
             
             /* Continuity Fix */
             startBrightness = Double.parseDouble(tasker.getVariable("currentbrightness"));
             
             /* Animation Config */
             dimmingThreshold = Double.parseDouble(tasker.getVariable("AAB_DimmingThreshold"));
             dimStart = Double.parseDouble(tasker.getVariable("dim_start"));
             
             /* Feature Flags */
             privilege = tasker.getVariable("AAB_Privilege");
             detectOverrides = "On".equals(tasker.getVariable("AAB_DetectOverrides"));
             adaptiveHandoff = "1".equals(tasker.getVariable("AAB_AdaptiveHandoff"));
             sdk = Integer.parseInt(tasker.getVariable("AAB_SDK"));
             isAtLeastSdk31 = (sdk >= 31);
             
             /* Logic Flags */
             /* Extra Dim requires Android 12 (SDK 31); older versions fall back to unprivileged overlay */
             isUnprivileged = "None".equals(privilege) || !isAtLeastSdk31;
             isNativeSecure = "Write Secure".equals(privilege) && isAtLeastSdk31;
             requiresTaskCall = !isUnprivileged && !isNativeSecure;
             
             /* System Access */
             cResolver = context.getContentResolver();
             consecutiveOutOfBounds = 0;
             
             /* --- LOGIC UPGRADE: Time-Based Override Threshold --- */
             /* Reduced threshold to 2 because we are checking less frequently (every 5 frames) */
             overrideTriggerThreshold = 2;
             
             /* --- STATE TRACKING (Optimization) --- */
             /* Track previous values to avoid redundant system writes (Battery Saver & Speed) */
             previousHardwareTarget = -1;
             previousDimVal = -1;
             previousAlpha = -1;
             
             /* Optimization: Cache Dimming Status locally to avoid IPC read inside loop */
             dimmingStatusVar = tasker.getVariable("AAB_DimmingStatus");
             dimmingStatusActive = (dimmingStatusVar != null && dimmingStatusVar.equals("1"));
             
             dimParams = new HashMap();
             overlayParams = new HashMap();
             
             /* Initialize tracking variable outside loop */
             calculated_bright = startBrightness;
             
             for (counter = 0; counter < loops; counter++) {
             
                 /* 1. Safety Check */
                 if ("true".equals(tasker.getVariable("AAB_Manual_Override"))) break;
             
                 /* 2. Calculate Values */
                 progress = loops <= 1 
                     ? 1.0 
                     : (double) counter / (loops - 1);
                     
                 /* Adaptive Handoff Logic: Follow System rather than computing */
                 if (adaptiveHandoff) {
                     try {
                         calculated_bright = Settings.System.getInt(cResolver, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS);
                     } catch (Exception e) {
                         calculated_bright = startBrightness + progress * (targetBrightness - startBrightness);
                     }
                 } else {
                     calculated_bright = startBrightness + progress * (targetBrightness - startBrightness);
                 }
                 
                 /* Dimming Curve */
                 dim_shell_double = dimStart + progress * (finalDim - dimStart);
                 dim_val = (int) Math.round(dim_shell_double);
                 
                 /* 3. Determine Hardware Target (PWM Logic) */
                 hardwareTarget = 0;
                 if (calculated_bright < dimmingThreshold) {
                     hardwareTarget = (int) Math.round(dimmingThreshold);
                 } else {
                     hardwareTarget = (int) Math.round(calculated_bright);
                 }
             
                 /* OPTIMIZATION: Write Hardware Brightness ONLY if changed */
                 if (hardwareTarget != previousHardwareTarget) {
                     /* Avoid writing back to the system if Adaptive Handoff is on and hardware brightness matches calculated brightness, to prevent disabling native auto-brightness */
                     if (!adaptiveHandoff || hardwareTarget != calculated_bright) {
                         Settings.System.putInt(cResolver, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS, hardwareTarget);
                     }
                     previousHardwareTarget = hardwareTarget;
                 }
             
                 /* 4. Override Detection (Throttled) */
                 if (detectOverrides && !adaptiveHandoff) {
                     /* OPTIMIZATION: Check only every 5 frames to reduce CPU load */
                     if (counter % 5 == 0) {
                         try {
                             actualBright = Settings.System.getInt(cResolver, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS);
                             
                             /* Tolerance is 10% of target, but minimum 4 units */
                             dynamicTolerance = (int) Math.max(4, hardwareTarget * 0.10);
                             
                             if (Math.abs(actualBright - hardwareTarget) > dynamicTolerance) {
                                 consecutiveOutOfBounds++;
                                 if (consecutiveOutOfBounds >= overrideTriggerThreshold) {
                                     tasker.setVariable("AAB_Manual_Override", "true");
                                     tasker.callTask("Manual Override", new HashMap()); 
                                     break;
                                 }
                             } else {
                                 consecutiveOutOfBounds = 0;
                             }
                         } catch (Exception e) {}
                     }
                 }
             
                 /* 5. APPLY DIMMING LOGIC */
                 
                 if (isUnprivileged) {
                     /* Check local cached boolean instead of IPC call */
                     if (!dimmingStatusActive) {
                          tasker.callTask("_ShowColorFilter", new HashMap());
                          tasker.setVariable("AAB_DimmingStatus", "1");
                          dimmingStatusActive = true;
                     }
                     
                     alphaVal = dim_val;
                     if (alphaVal > 253) alphaVal = 253;
                     if (alphaVal < 0) alphaVal = 0;
             
                     /* OPTIMIZATION: Only calculate hex and update overlay if Alpha Value Changed */
                     if (alphaVal != previousAlpha) {
                         hexStr = Integer.toHexString(alphaVal);
                         if (hexStr.length() < 2) hexStr = "0" + hexStr;
                         colorCode = "#" + hexStr + "000000";
                         
                         tasker.setVariable("AAB_HexOverlay", colorCode);
                         overlayParams.put("par1", colorCode);
                         tasker.callTask("_OverlayColorUpdate", overlayParams);
                         
                         previousAlpha = alphaVal;
                     }
                     
                     /* OPTIMIZATION: Throttle global status updates */
                     if (counter % 5 == 0) {
                         dimPct = dim_shell_double / 2.55;
                         /* Primitive math rounding replaces BigDecimal */
                         roundedDim = Math.round(dimPct * 10.0) / 10.0;
                         tasker.setVariable("AAB_DimmingCurrent", String.valueOf(roundedDim));
                         tasker.setVariable("AAB_DimmingDS", String.valueOf(dim_val));
                     }
                 } 
                 else if (isNativeSecure) {
                     try {
                         if (dim_val > 100) dim_val = 100;
                         if (dim_val < 0) dim_val = 0;
             
                         /* OPTIMIZATION: Only write Secure Setting if value changed */
                         if (dim_val != previousDimVal) {
                             Settings.Secure.putInt(cResolver, "reduce_bright_colors_level", dim_val);
                             previousDimVal = dim_val;
                         }
                         
                         if (!dimmingStatusActive) {

                             tasker.setVariable("AAB_DimmingStatus", "1");
                             dimmingStatusActive = true;
                         }

                         if (counter % 5 == 0) {

                             tasker.setVariable("AAB_DimmingCurrent", String.valueOf(roundedDim));
                             tasker.setVariable("AAB_DimmingDS", String.valueOf(dim_val));
                         }
                     } catch (Exception e) {}
                 }
                 else if (requiresTaskCall) {
                     /* Task Call Logic with fixed Guard clauses to prevent Rejected Copy errors. */
                     isLastLoop = (counter == loops - 1);
                     
                     /* Get fresh TRUN value */
                     trun = tasker.getVariable("TRUN");
                     taskName = "Apply Dimming (Privileged)";
                     
                     /* FRAME DROPPING LOGIC */
                     /* If the task is running... */
                     if (trun != null && trun.contains(taskName)) {
                         /* If it's the last loop, we MUST wait for the previous task to finish
                            so we can apply the final brightness value reliably. */
                         if (isLastLoop) {
                             /* wait for the previous instance to finish (No timeout!) */
                             while (trun.contains(taskName)) {
                                 try { Thread.sleep(5); } catch (Exception e) {}
                                 trun = tasker.getVariable("TRUN");
                             }
                         } 
                         /* If it's NOT the last loop, just skip this frame to prevent

                         else {

                         }

                     tasker.callTask(taskName, dimParams);

                     /* If this is the last loop, we want to make sure the task we just called 
                        actually starts before we finish the script, ensuring the UI is consistent. */
                     if (isLastLoop) {
                          sTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                          /* Wait up to 200ms for the task to appear in TRUN */
                          trun = tasker.getVariable("TRUN");
                          while ((trun == null || !trun.contains(taskName)) && (System.currentTimeMillis() - sTime < 200)) {
                              try { Thread.sleep(5); } catch (Exception e) {}
                              trun = tasker.getVariable("TRUN");
                          }
                     }
                 }
             
                 /* 6. Update UI Variables */
                 /* OPTIMIZATION: Throttle UI Global updates to every 5 frames */
                 /* OPTIMIZATION: Use Primitive Math instead of BigDecimal object allocation */

                     currBrightStr = "";
                     if (calculated_bright < dimmingThreshold) {
                          /* Round to 1 decimal place: (int)(val * 10) / 10.0 */
                          roundedVal = Math.round(calculated_bright * 10.0) / 10.0;
                          currBrightStr = String.valueOf(roundedVal);
                     } else {
                          currBrightStr = String.valueOf(Math.round(calculated_bright));
                     }
                     tasker.setVariable("AAB_CurrentBright", currBrightStr);
                 }
             
                 /* 7. Wait Loop */
                 timeSpent = System.currentTimeMillis() - engineStartTime;
                 targetTime = (long)((counter + 1) * wait);
                 adjustedWait = targetTime - timeSpent;
                 
                 try {
                     if (adjustedWait > 0 && counter < loops - 1) {
                         Thread.sleep(adjustedWait);
                     }
                 } catch (InterruptedException e) { break; }
             }
             
             /* Post-Loop Cleanup */
             if (!"true".equals(tasker.getVariable("AAB_Manual_Override"))) {
                 if (adaptiveHandoff) {
                     try {
                         calculated_bright = Settings.System.getInt(cResolver, Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS);
                     } catch (Exception e) {}
                 } else {
                     calculated_bright = targetBrightness;
                 }
             }
             
             /* Final update to ensure target is reached exactly in UI (Primitive Math) */
             if (calculated_bright < dimmingThreshold) {
                  roundedVal = Math.round(calculated_bright * 10.0) / 10.0;
                  currBrightStr = String.valueOf(roundedVal);
             } else {
                  currBrightStr = String.valueOf(Math.round(calculated_bright));
             }
             tasker.setVariable("AAB_CurrentBright", currBrightStr);
             
             endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
             tasker.setVariable("java_loop_duration", String.valueOf(endTime - engineStartTime));
             tasker.setVariable("AutoBrightRunning", "0");
             tasker.setVariable("calculated_brightness_smooth", String.valueOf(calculated_bright));

             File getCleanFile(String input, String basePath) {
                 if (input.startsWith("/")) return new File(input);
                 String fileName = input.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9.\\- ]", "_");
                 if (!fileName.toLowerCase().endsWith(".json")) fileName += ".json";
                 return new File(basePath, fileName);
             }
             
             double getG(String name, double def) {
                 String val = tasker.getVariable(name);
                 if (val != null && val.length() > 0) {
                     try {
                         return Double.parseDouble(val);
                     } catch(Exception e) {}
                 }
                 return def;
             }
             
             boolean getB(String name, boolean def) {
                 String val = tasker.getVariable(name);
                 if (val != null) {
                     return val.equalsIgnoreCase("On") || val.equalsIgnoreCase("true");
                 }
                 return def;
             }
             
             int getI(String name, int def) {
                 String val = tasker.getVariable(name);

                         return (int)Double.parseDouble(val);
                     } catch(Exception e) {}
                 }
                 return def;
             }

                 tasker.setVariable(name, val);
